create.title: Target-sized recombined R1 arithmetic residue
create.statement_tex: Let delta=1/4-u/2-v and R_(1,v)(1-(u+v)/2)=-(pi i sqrt X)/delta times integral_(1<=x<=N_X)x^(delta-1/2)e(sqrt(Xx))dx. Prove that the accepted physical symmetric-profile limit of sum_j integral integral A_j(u,v)R_(1,v)(1-(u+v)/2)L(1-u-v,chi_4)dvdu is O_epsilon(X^epsilon) on the normalized M1 scale, with all scale floors, the top one-sided profile, height profile, and residue ledger retained. A candidate exact return formula introduces y=xr through 1/delta=integral_0^1 r^(delta-1)dr and then uses fixed-y Abel summation in q.
create.next_action: Derive the physical y-integral return exactly, justify the conditionally convergent L-series and outside-profile limits, and prove or refute the fixed-y chi_4/q sampled-BV bound.
